1.title: LabStock
1.subtitle: Mobile inventory management and optimization system for the quality department.
1.problemText: Before LabStock, the control of reagents, materials, and equipment was done entirely through spreadsheets and paper records. This caused a massive loss of operational time and a concerning lack of traceability.

problemPoints.title: Downtime
problemPoints.desc: Loss of 1.5 hours daily per user transcribing paper notes to a desktop PC.

problemPoints.title: Discrepancy
problemPoints.desc: 1 in 5 Excel entries did not match actual physical stock due to data entry errors.

problemPoints.title: Shrinkage
problemPoints.desc: 15% of the budget wasted annually on reagents expiring on the shelves.

1.architectureSubtitle: Local infrastructure with high availability and mobile access.
1.architectureText1: To solve the reliance on unstable internet connections and reduce operational costs, I structured a Client-Server architecture deployed on an independent local network (Intranet).
1.architectureText2: I used a router configured as an exclusive Access Point for operational devices, connecting to a local server hosting the MySQL database and the Node.js Backend.

features.title: Auto-Recovery
features.desc: Configuration of auto-start services. If the server reboots, the system restores without human intervention.

features.title: Dynamic Security
features.desc: Implementation of specific Firewall Rules and role management (Administrators vs. Lab Technicians).

metrics.label: Faster
metrics.desc: Manual logging time dropped from 10 minutes to 45 seconds on mobile.

metrics.label: Annual Shrinkage
metrics.desc: Achieved through the automated preventive expiration alert system.

metrics.label: In Licenses
metrics.desc: Developed 100% with enterprise-grade Open Source technologies.

2.title: TourCraft
2.subtitle: Digital tourism marketplace focused on the Riviera Maya to democratize local tourism.
2.problemText: Independent guides and small local businesses in the Riviera Maya face a severe lack of visibility compared to large tour operators. This monopolizes the market and hinders connections with tourists seeking authentic experiences.

problemPoints.title: Digital Invisibility
problemPoints.desc: Local guides lack accessible and modern platforms to offer their services directly.

problemPoints.title: Tourism Monopoly
problemPoints.desc: Large agencies capture all attention, leaving residents with no economic growth opportunities.

problemPoints.title: Lack of Trust
problemPoints.desc: Absence of a centralized review system to validate the service quality of independent guides.

2.architectureSubtitle: Client-Server architecture under the MVC pattern.
2.architectureText1: I developed the platform using the MERN stack, implementing a clear separation of concerns through the Model-View-Controller pattern. The entire process was managed under the SCRUM agile methodology.
2.architectureText2: The ecosystem integrates destination exploration with a hyper-local focus, verified user profiles, advertising spaces for local businesses, and a complete booking simulation flow.

features.title: B2C Ecosystem
features.desc: Direct, middleman-free connection between the end consumer (tourist) and the service provider (guide or business).

features.title: Sustainable Tourism
features.desc: Promotes the local economy by distributing tourism revenue directly to the community.

metrics.label: Tech Stack

metrics.label: Architecture

metrics.label: Methodology

header.title: My Hobbies
header.description: The disciplines outside of software development that shape my focus, nurture my creativity, and keep my mind sharp.

items.title: Tennis
items.description: Whether practicing it on the court or following it as a spectator, tennis is a discipline that demands consistency, strategy, and mental agility. It helps me maintain physical balance and inspires me to push my own limits in every set.

items.title: E-sports
items.description: The competitive scene in titles like Valorant fascinates me due to the level of coordination, communication, and tactics it demands. It is a high-pressure environment where split-second decision-making and team synergy define victory.

items.title: Haute Horlogerie
items.description: I am truly passionate about micromechanics and the history behind watches. I dedicate my time to researching and learning about calibers, complications, and the craftsmanship of this industry, with the ultimate goal of building my own collection in the future.

items.title: Music & Percussion
items.description: I understand music as an exceptional expression of human brilliance, especially in genres of great technical complexity like jazz, blues, and boleros. I deeply enjoy studying music theory and learning the drums to appreciate this art from its core.

items.title: Reading
items.description: Reading is one of my favorite activities, as it allows me to immerse myself in different worlds and perspectives. I enjoy everything from narrative to lyric poetry, and I am always looking for new books to explore.
